text:
Maya (SE): Heads up — prepping POC with NorthLake Bank. They listed must-haves: per-tenant domain ownership verification, SCIM provisioning with fast deprovision, SAML attribute->RBAC mapping, and ability to geo-lock auth flows. POC target next Tue. Need a short checklist and answers for: DNS TXT vs delegated CNAME verification, temporary test-domain option for POC, SCIM rate/consistency, SAML attribute mapping examples, and any pricing impacts.

Kevin (AE): On domain verification — do they need delegated verification for subdomains they control, or will they provision TXT records? Customer prefers a flow that doesn’t touch prod DNS for initial tests.

Rachel (Infra): We support two flows: DNS TXT verification (standard) and delegated CNAME token for org-owned domains. For delegated flow we generate a one-time token via the Console API and they add a CNAME pointing to our verifier. Example:
```
# generate token
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/domain-verifications \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDCONSOLE" \
  -d '{"domain":"corp.northlake.com","method":"cname"}'
# response includes cname_target they add to DNS
```
For POC you can use our staging verifier with a test subdomain (we issue a short-lived token) so they don't modify prod DNS. Production requires TXT or CNAME on their DNS.

Olivia (Security): SCIM notes — we run SCIM over HTTPS. For customers requiring stronger protections we offer: IP allowlisting, customer-managed egress NAT IPs (Dedicated/Private), and optional outbound mTLS for SCIM push. We do NOT currently support signed SCIM payloads (e.g., detached JWS) out of the box; can evaluate for an enterprise add-on.
For SAML: attribute mapping to RBAC is supported in the Console: map incoming SAML attrs (e.g., groups, eduPersonScopedAffiliation) to role names. We persist auth events to audit logs (who, when, IP).

Sam (Sales Ops): Pricing Q — if they spin up Dedicated capacity for sensitive tenants, will SCIM calls be charged differently?

Kevin (AE): SCIM API usage is not metered separately for hosted; it's considered control plane traffic. For Dedicated/Private the platform fee covers control plane traffic; very high-volume SCIM (>> 100k ops/day) should be scoped into the committed capacity conversation. Seat/licensing counts and Dedicated GPUs are the primary pricing levers, not individual SCIM calls.

Rachel (Infra): SCIM perf/limits: default throttling is 500 req/min per org in hosted. We can increase limits for Dedicated. Typical deprovision propagation is 30–90s under normal conditions; on heavy retry/backoff it can be longer. We also offer webhooks for user-status change events if they prefer event-driven deprovisioning.

Maya (SE): For SAML attribute mapping — can you drop a sample mapping JSON I can share? Also customer asked about mapping SAML group -> multiple roles (e.g., group A -> roleX + roleY).

Rachel (Infra): Sample mapping (console JSON snippet):
```
{
  "mappings": [
    {"saml_attr":"groups","match":"northlake-admins","roles":["admin","billing-admin"]},
    {"saml_attr":"department","match":"legal","roles":["read-only"]}
  ]
}
```
Yes, one group can map to multiple platform roles. Policy evaluation order is top->bottom; we can add a deny rule if needed.

Olivia (Security): Audit + compliance: we retain admin/audit logs 90 days by default. For enterprise contracts we can extend retention, add syslog/forwarding to customer SIEM, and enable KMS integration for at-rest keys. They asked about domain claim proofs in logs — we log verification events (token issued, token validated, DNS check outcome) with admin identity.

Kevin (AE): SAML cert rotation — customer asks if we support multiple active SP certs and automated rotation. Answer: yes, we support two active certs for smooth rollover; rotation can be automated via API.

deploy-bot: canary rollout for domain-verification-service v2 deployed to us-west-2 — success :rocket:

Maya (SE): Perfect. Final ask: can someone DM me (or drop as a GDoc link) the short one-pager: 1) POC checklist, 2) SAML attr mapping sample, 3) SCIM SLA & rate limits, 4) domain verification flows (TXT/CNAME/staging), and 5) audit log retention options. I’ll send to NorthLake legal and infra.

Kevin (AE): Will compile and send a single attachment. ETA 2 hours. :thumbsup:

Rachel (Infra): I'll attach SCIM SLA and the Console API example for token generation in the doc.

Olivia (Security): I'll add the audit/retention language and optional mTLS note.

Maya (SE): Thanks team — filing POC kickoff for Tue.
